EventData.Data: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue' $marker = 'SOC002-PHASE5-ENCODED-POWERSHELL' $b64 = '' "=== SOC-002 PHASE5 TASK2 CONTROLLED ENCODED POWERSHELL ===" "MARKER = $marker" "OPERATOR_HOST = $env:COMPUTERNAME" "OPERATOR_ACCT = $([System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name)" "PRE_LOCAL = $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')" "PRE_UTC = $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))" "PAYLOAD_B64_LEN = $($b64.Length)" "CHILD_CMD = powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand $b64" "--- executing (SINGLE run) ---" $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew() $out = & powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand $b64 2>&1 $sw.Stop() "CHILD_RC = $LASTEXITCODE" "CHILD_DUR_MS = $($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds)" "POST_UTC = $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ'))" "--- child stdout ---" $out | ForEach-Object { "$_" } "--- end child stdout ---"
